insights.body: For All App, App Total Install in US is -32.9% while all countries together are -52.9% — a gap of +20.1pp. US is about 42% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Next period outlook — Expect App Total Revenue to go up in about 7 days — more of the people installing are subscribing, mostly YMK.
insights.body: App Total New Subs is -14.8% while App Total Install is only -52.9% — a bigger share of people who installed are subscribing than usual (+38.2pp more growth). New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So expect App Total Revenue to go up in about 7 days. Most of the increase comes from YMK (-4.0%); YCP is -30.4%.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — YCV turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (39.6% vs 23.8% overall).
insights.body: In YCV, 39.6% of installs turn into new subs, versus 23.8% across all markets and apps (+15.8pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. YCV is about 10% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -13.8% this period.

insights.title: Market trend — YMK is gaining ground fast on turning installs into subs (+89.4%, now 23.9%).
insights.body: In YMK, 23.9% of installs now turn into new subs — +89.4% versus last period. It is about 46% of revenue (a big revenue market): more of the people downloading are subscribing, which should help revenue within a week or two.
